name: How long does it take to paint a vacant rental unit?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to paint a vacant rental unit?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration for painting a vacant rental unit varies based on its size, the scope of work (e.g., walls only vs. walls, ceilings, and trim), and any necessary prep work like patching or repairs. A standard one-bedroom apartment might take 2-3 days, while a larger multi-bedroom home could require 4-7 days. This estimate includes preparation, painting, and drying time. Our team works efficiently to minimize vacancy periods for landlords in areas like Daly City and San Mateo.
acceptedAnswer.description: Painting a vacant rental unit typically takes 2-3 days for a one-bedroom and 4-7 days for larger homes, depending on size and scope.
